size_help.when: Real attention on size-guide/size-picker (not just page dwell).
size_help.title: Between sizes?

missed_discount.when: A missed_discount offer exists (a code not yet applied) and there's hesitation on cart/checkout.
missed_discount.title: Save on your order
missed_discount.body: Use {code} to save ৳{saving} on your order.

auto_discount_active.when: An auto_discount_active offer exists (already applied automatically) — informational only, no code to mention.
auto_discount_active.title: Discount applied

similar_on_promo.when: A similar_on_promo offer exists and there's real attention or a return visit on the current (non-promo) product.
similar_on_promo.title: Worth a look

delivery_gap.when: A delivery_gap offer exists with a real hesitation signal (cart/checkout page + dwelling or bouncing).
delivery_gap.title: Almost free delivery
delivery_gap.body: Add {fill_with_name} (৳{fill_with_price}) and delivery is free — you're ৳{gap} away.
delivery_gap.tone: Concrete, exact amounts, one clear ask.

cart_under_threshold.when: A cart_under_threshold offer exists (an open cart under the free-delivery threshold, any gap size) while the shopper is BROWSING (not already on cart/checkout — that's delivery_gap's recipe instead).
cart_under_threshold.title: Free delivery is close
cart_under_threshold.body: Add {fill_with_name} (৳{fill_with_price}) and delivery is free — you're ৳{gap} away.
cart_under_threshold.tone: Concrete, exact amounts, one clear ask — same voice as delivery_gap.

checkout_bounce.when: patterns.checkoutBounce is true — the shopper reached checkout and then left to a different page (a login wall, a back-nav to cart/shop) without a later checkout visit.
checkout_bounce.title: Still want it?
checkout_bounce.body: Your cart is saved — pick up where you left off.
checkout_bounce.tone: Reassuring, no blame, one clear next step.

search_help.when: search.results is exactly 0 for the shopper's current search.q AND the store found 1-3 real catalog matches (offers[].candidates).
search_help.title: Found a match

stuck_checkout.when: Rage clicks or repeated form-field friction on /checkout with no concrete offer fact to hand over.
stuck_checkout.title: Trouble checking out?
stuck_checkout.body: You can also complete payment via {payment_method} if this isn't working.
stuck_checkout.tone: Calm, offers an alternative, no blame.

low_stock.when: facts.keys.stock is low for the current product/selected variant — a concrete near-miss fact.
low_stock.title: Almost gone
low_stock.body: Only {stock} left in {size_selected} — grab it before it's out.
low_stock.tone: Urgent but factual, one concrete number.
